reference_price_status: OFFICIAL NSE close of 2026-10-13 from BhavCopy_NSE_CM_0_0_0_20261013_F_0000.csv.zip (published ~16:34 IST); equals Google Finance / stockanalysis / Yahoo prints
location_model: L0 (no model passed its pre-registered gate)

probabilities.note: probabilities are model-based on the trailing 500 standardised residuals. Interval coverage was TESTED, not proven: selected R model, Final window n=317, 90% coverage 0.918 (Kupiec p=0.27, but power to reject 0.88 is only ~22%); Dev+Val 90% coverage 0.8815 (Kupiec p=0.017); 50% intervals ran narrow in Final (0.464). Tail and centre masses are not separately validated.

market_status_at_forecast: NSE cash market closed (13-Oct-2026 15:30 IST); no pre-open yet; target session 14-Oct-2026 09:15-15:30 IST (pre-open 09:00-09:08); closing price = closing-auction price since 3-Aug-2026
horizon: one session: 2026-10-14 (Wed), open gap G, open-to-close I, close-to-close R, high/low vs P0
method: Pre-registered (docs/PREREGISTRATION.md, commit 711805d): filtered-historical-simulation quantiles = sigma_t x median-centred trailing-500 standardised residuals; sigma from S6 (geometric blend of GARCH(1,1)-t and HAR on gap^2+Garman-Klass) for R and I, S4 (HAR-GK) for G, HAR for the range; location L0 (median = P0) because no location model passed its gate; high/low from a joint OHLC bootstrap scaled by the S6 sigma (exploratory, evaluated walk-forward). Parameters refit on all sessions through 2026-10-13.

predictive_value_statement.scale/volatility: Demonstrated against the pre-registered expanding-RMS benchmark (Final window DM p=0.0006) but NOT distinguishable from a one-parameter rescale of that benchmark in Final (p=0.44) and only weakly better than a trailing-250-day untimed benchmark (p=0.084); evidence of true day-to-day timing is moderate and strongest on the pooled Dev+Val sample.
predictive_value_statement.direction: NOT found. Ridge/logit location models failed every pre-registered gate on Validation+Final (OOS R2 negative, accuracy below the best constant). There is insufficient evidence for a reliable directional forecast.
predictive_value_statement.gap_location: A positive median gap (+0.3%) held 2019-2025 (post-hoc rule selected it) but disappeared after the closing-auction change of 2026-08-03; the gap median is set to zero by judgement.
predictive_value_statement.intraday_path: Not modelled. Conditional descriptions use daily-OHLC frequencies and 36 validated post-CAS 15-minute sessions; first-hour direction did not predict the rest of the day (r=-0.11).

invalidation_conditions_whole_forecast: Session 2026-10-14 is not a normal full trading day (holiday notice, market-wide halt, or BSE Ltd-specific trading halt).
Official NSE close of 2026-10-13 differs from the provisional 3,375.40 by more than 0.3% (prices are then re-based from the return quantiles; the return forecast itself is unchanged).

SEBI issues its settlement/CAS circular or a regulator/exchange announces a fee, tax or expiry change before the open: the distribution then no longer applies (event overlay in results/scenarios.json is the only guide, and it is subjective).
A gap larger than 3 sigma_G (about +/-2.8%) at the open: the stock is in a different information state; condition on the observed open (close = open x exp(I), sigma_I = 2.23%).
known_limitations: No order-book, bid-ask, short-interest, securities-lending, FII/DII daily flow or GIFT-Nifty data were available.
Intraday bars come from Yahoo through a summarising fetch and only descriptively; the gated models use daily exchange data.
Closing price definition changed on 2026-08-03 (VWAP -> closing auction): only 49 sessions of the new regime exist.
Prices are price returns (no dividend re-basing); the Rs10 dividend went ex on 2026-07-10, none is due on 2026-10-14.
Scenario thresholds (+/-1.5%) and the event-hazard overlay are my choices; the probabilities are not calibrated for the three-way partition.
reassessment: Scheduled by the user/analyst only: pre-open indicative price (09:08 IST), 10:15 IST, close. No automatic monitoring exists in this session.
TIMESTAMP_LIMITATION: Written and committed AFTER the 2026-10-14 open (sandbox idle overnight). The information set is restricted to <= 2026-10-13 22:00 IST by rule and by instruction to every workstream, not by the clock; v2 is therefore NOT an independently timestamped pre-session forecast. The scorable pre-session forecast of record is v1 (commit e8a0f22, 2026-10-13 21:11 IST). The lead analyst looked at no 14-Oct price, volume or headline before this file was committed.
